metadata.question: Did Cincinnati, Ohio have its warmest February in 2018 (surface temperatures at 2 meters) compared to 2010 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: ERA5-Land monthly averaged data (2m temperature) - Time: I need monthly data for February in 2018 and Feb means for each year from 2010-2017 to establish which is the warmest. 2. Masking strategy: - Monthly reanalysis data doesn't require cloud masking, so None needed. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null: - ERA5-Land is complete so data should exist. However must be prepared for case where I accidentally pull null (rare with ERA5 monthly) - A 0C might be plausible for a February mean, but we must also guard against null returns. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.51, 39.10]) # Cincinnati, Ohio feb = list(range(2, 3)) # February bands kept all months # 2. Data Acquisition & Check era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY') def monthMean(year): img = (era.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .first()) val = img.select('temperature_2m') \ .subtract(273.15) \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('temperature_2m') return val # 2010-2017 baseline baseline = [] for y in range(2010, 2018): v = monthMean(y).getInfo() if monthMean(y) else None print(f"{y} Feb: {v:.2f}" if v else f"{y} Feb: None") baseline.append(v) # 2018 value t18 = monthMean(2018).getInfo() print(f"2018 Feb: {t18:.2f}") # Check if t18 is None: print("Null 2018 result") print("C3") elif None in baseline: print("Missing baseline data") print("C1") else: print(f"2018 vs max (2010-17): {t18:.2f} vs {max(baseline):.2f}") print("A" if t18 > max(baseline) else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.51, 39.10])  # Cincinnati, Ohio
feb = list(range(2, 3))  # February bands kept all months

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY')
def monthMean(year):
    img = (era.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
              .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month'))
              .first())
    val = img.select('temperature_2m') \
             .subtract(273.15) \
             .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) \
             .get('temperature_2m')
    return val

# 2010-2017 baseline
baseline = []
for y in range(2010, 2018):
    v = monthMean(y).getInfo() if monthMean(y) else None
    print(f"{y} Feb: {v:.2f}" if v else f"{y} Feb: None")
    baseline.append(v)

# 2018 value
t18 = monthMean(2018).getInfo()
print(f"2018 Feb: {t18:.2f}")

# Check
if t18 is None:
    print("Null 2018 result")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif None in baseline:
    print("Missing baseline data")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2018 vs max (2010-17): {t18:.2f} vs {max(baseline):.2f}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if t18 > max(baseline) else "<answer>B</answer>")
